description: This file contains the implementation of the LoanInterestAccrual class and related functions for managing loan interest accruals, including validation, GL entry creation, and interest calculation for demand and term loans within an ERPNext system.

classes.name: LoanInterestAccrual
classes.description: A class representing a loan interest accrual record, handling validation, GL entries, and submission within the ERPNext framework.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the loan interest accrual data, ensuring mandatory fields are present.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Creates GL entries upon submission of the loan interest accrual.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions required when a loan interest accrual is canceled, including updating the repayment schedule.

methods.name: update_is_accrued
methods.description: Updates the 'is_accrued' status of a repayment schedule.

methods.name: make_gl_entries
methods.description: Generates and posts GL entries for interest accruals.
